# Stellar Property Management

> Licensed community association management for condominium, HOA, and townhome associations in Chicago and the North Shore of Illinois.

Stellar Property Management serves community association boards. The company does not market residential rental management services.

## Business facts

- Association management only: condominiums, HOAs, and townhome communities; no apartment-rental management
- Office: 5107 N Western Ave #1S, Chicago, IL 60625
- Phone: 773-728-0652
- Service area: Chicago neighborhoods and North Shore communities
- Pricing: customized flat-fee management starting at $20 per unit per month
- Capital projects: no separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee; third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses
- Established: 2007
- Illinois Community Association Management Firm license: 291000211
- Memberships: Community Associations Institute and CAI Illinois Chapter
- Management focus: community associations only; prospective rental-property clients should seek a rental-management specialist
- Proposal process: board consultation, property and document review, customized scope, and a managed 30–60 day transition
- Public Google profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6022006747972898171

## Publishing and attribution

Articles cover Illinois condominium, HOA, and townhome association governance, finances, maintenance, compliance, and board operations. Article byline: Mirsad Cerimovic, CAM, CMCA, AMS. Publisher: Stellar Property Management.

Dates on articles are publication dates. Future-dated articles are not included in the public blog, prerendered output, or sitemap until their scheduled Chicago publication date.
